caption: The drawing features a single brass-colored object placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object is a cylindrical candle holder with a wide, shallow, circular base that has a slightly raised edge. The base is sectioned by a geometric pattern of curved lines radiating from the center. Attached to one side of the base is a small, rounded handle with a thumb rest. The central portion of the object rises vertically as a straight column, decorated with horizontal bands and a small round knob on its side, suggesting an adjustable feature. The top end of the cylinder flares outward in a short, wide lip designed to hold a candle. The shading is done primarily in yellow and gray tones, giving the object a metallic appearance and representing light and shadow for a three-dimensional effect. There is a thin rectangular outline framing the drawing, and the name "PHILIP JOHNSON" is inscribed in the bottom left corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
